proposal: The Mandate recommends updating guidelines and tax law so nonresident parents with child support orders can receive a nondependent child support tax credit similar to the earned income tax credit, linking visitation and child support courts as Texas did, and inducing each state to adopt a smartphone application for child support payments that also tracks informal support (pp. 478 to 479).

status_summary: No child support tax credit, visitation linkage initiative or state payment application program was found. ACF's child support rulemaking in 2026 concerns other topics: a proposed rule published 2026-06-18 would remove child support regulations it calls duplicative or obsolete, including the regulatory restatement of the State Disbursement Unit requirement, while stating the statutory obligations are unchanged, and a proposed rule published 2026-06-09 would rescind the December 2024 rule allowing federal matching funds for employment services for noncustodial parents.
